issues.title: 全新数据库无法从已提交 migration 链部署
issues.original_claim: 空库 prisma migrate deploy 因 baseline 未创建 visible_menu_items 而中断（第一遍独立 PG 实测 P3018/42703）。
issues.reproduction_class: A (phase-1 live PostgreSQL test; not re-executed this round per instruction)
issues.root_cause: column introductions went through runtime DDL (tenantSync.js:110-155 ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS) and db push, never sedimented into migrations; baseline (2026-07-26, generated from then-current schema.prisma via migrate diff --from-empty) lacks visible_menu_items (source assertion), while 2026-08-14 unify (:15 ALTER COLUMN) and revert (:13) assume it exists on the then-production database -> chain only self-consistent on db-push-era databases, breaks on empty-database replay
issues.baseline_vs_later_relationship: baseline is an adoption anchor, not a replayable origin; its header documents production onboarding as 'prisma migrate resolve --applied 20260726000000_baseline' (register without replaying)
possible_production_states: state-1: resolve --applied baseline executed -> chain healthy on that DB, but empty-replay still broken
state-2: never resolved -> first migrate deploy fails on CREATE TABLE already exists -> deploy.sh FIRST_DEPLOY=false -> fail -> redeployment blocked

state-3: first-deploy fallback db push used after migrate deploy failure -> _prisma_migrations retains failed record -> next deploy (non-first) meets failed migration -> fail -> permanently blocked until manual resolve
issues.production_state_note: which state production is in requires read-only inspection of _prisma_migrations (prohibited this round); recorded as a NEEDS_RUNTIME_VERIFICATION sub-premise that does not change the main verdict
deploy_sh_secondary: deploy.sh:512 'npx prisma migrate deploy 2>/dev/null' swallows failure output
fallback branch performs no migrate resolve handling for the failed record (source assertion)
fix_without_breaking_existing: do NOT modify the baseline file itself

insert patch migration between baseline and unify (e.g. 20260726100000_add_customization_columns_if_missing, all ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS, jsonb to match then-production) — idempotent on resolved DBs, makes empty replay pass unify/revert
remove 2>/dev/null in deploy.sh; after db-push fallback, explicitly handle failed records (migrate resolve --rolled-back) or fail-fast with guidance
production onboarding strategy (resolve --applied or not) per actual _prisma_migrations state, arbitrated by Astra

first_pass_comparison.note: first pass already anticipated the failed-record problem ('will not auto-resolve failed migration history state'); this round concretizes the three production states and the non-breaking fix design

issues.severity_rationale: empty environments cannot deploy from the controlled chain (live-tested); production redeployment has code paths to hard failure if unresolved; fallback masks failures and leaves persistent failed state

issues.title: 启动自愈默认执行可丢数据的 schema push，且租户失败仍汇总成功
issues.original_claim: 启动时 AUTO_SYNC_TENANTS 未置 false 或部署调用租户同步；--accept-data-loss 允许未审批变更；单校失败被吞、汇总仍成功。
issues.may_execute_vs_must_execute: MUST execute by default: server.js:372-382 calls selfHealTenantSchemas() at listen unless AUTO_SYNC_TENANTS === 'false' (unset by default; .env.example does not set it); deploy.sh:577-578 additionally invokes db:sync during deployment
error_swallowing: sync-tenant-schemas.mjs exits 1 only on top-level reject (never fires for per-tenant failures)
deploy.sh:578 '|| fail' therefore never triggers for partial failures -> deployment continues
issues.hidden_guard_found_this_round: tenantSync.js:174-179 syncs only status:'active' schools (narrows blast radius; comment-level discipline against destructive changes is not a technical block)
issues.actual_failure_mode: destructive schema.prisma changes are pushed to all active tenants at every restart, silently dropping columns/data; partial failures invisible to deployment
issues.severity_rationale: default-on destructive push plus swallowed failures; hard ordering dependency: AUD-008 must be fixed first, otherwise removing --accept-data-loss regresses P2022 tenant drift (the very problem this self-heal was built for)

summary.note: AUD-008 carries one NEEDS_RUNTIME_VERIFICATION sub-premise (production _prisma_migrations state) that does not change its main verdict

shared_root_causes: restore staging namespace is a fixed derived name (AUD-004 + AUD-005): collides with real tenants AND lets concurrent restores trample each other; one refactor (random unique staging name + per-school advisory lock + ownership ledger) resolves both
backup artifacts built on non-atomic, non-exclusive point-in-time operations (AUD-006 + AUD-007): no shared snapshot for counts, no entropy/lock for filenames

schema evolution relies on runtime DDL / db push instead of controlled migrations (AUD-008 + AUD-009): columns never sedimented cause empty-replay breakage; startup self-heal with --accept-data-loss papers over drift — fixing 008 is prerequisite to safely fixing 009
trust-the-environment assumptions in tests and example config (AUD-039 + AUD-044): tests trust DATABASE_URL / auto .env; startup trusts placeholder secret
arbitration_needed: final severity for AUD-006 / AUD-007 (P1 vs P2)
final severity for AUD-044 (deployment-dependent catastrophic tail vs documentation risk; near-zero fix cost)
AUD-008 production onboarding strategy: authorize a read-only inspection of _prisma_migrations to determine state-1/2/3, then decide resolve --applied + patch-migration plan

AUD-009 architecture trade-off: P2022 anti-drift self-heal (deliberate availability design) vs silent data loss of --accept-data-loss; whether to demote self-heal to check-and-alert gated behind AUD-008 completion
AUD-005 fix scope: per-school advisory lock and write barrier across Caddy/application layers
fix_order_dependencies: AUD-008 -> AUD-009 (hard): sediment schema evolution into migrations before demoting the self-heal, else tenant P2022 drift regresses
AUD-004 + AUD-005 (same batch): one restore-engine refactor; random staging name from 004 also removes 005's same-name trampling
AUD-006 + AUD-007 (same batch): backup artifact consistency refactor (shared-snapshot counts + unique filenames/atomic publish/scope lock)
AUD-039 and AUD-044 independent and parallelizable (044 near-zero cost, do immediately)
deploy.sh fixes for AUD-008 (drop 2>/dev/null, handle failed records) must ship in the same batch as its migration patch to avoid intermediate states
